text:
Sam L: Who's in for the office March Madness bracket? Quick vote — lock your bracket by Friday noon or let people swap until Sunday? Also snack duty rules. :thinking_face:
Priya K: Lock Friday. Hate last-minute chaos. Also happy to bring snacks if we do pizza :pizza:
Mateo R: Can we allow one swap? My bracket imploded after an upset. Maybe one 'sub' until Sunday midnight so people can fix a bad first-round pick.
Jin W: Agree on 1 swap but after that it's locked. Also tiebreaker idea: total points in the championship game (both teams). Closest wins the snack pot.
OpsBot: Poll created — vote here: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-bracket-poll (options: "Lock Friday" or "Allow 1 Swap"). I'll close the poll automatically in 24h.
Nora: Is there a $ entry? Or just bragging rights + free lunch? I'm good either way.
Dan: Let's make it $5 to the winner and they pick snacks for a week. Small, but motivates people :moneybag:
Kelsey: If it's paid, can ops handle collection? I'll Venmo to @Kelsey or set up a quick Stripe link.
Sam L: @Kelsey awesome — can you create a collection link? Also @Priya will you still bring pizza if winner chooses sushi? :joy:
Priya K: I will bring pizza regardless. :pizza: Also adding a tiebreaker: guess the combined final score — closest gets a +1 bonus for tie resolution.
Mateo R: One more rule suggestion: no professional team picks—college only (obvs).
Jin W: Reminder: bracket posts/updates go in #random, not #eng. Also @OpsBot can you pin the poll and the bracket sheet once people sign up?
OpsBot: Pinned the poll and the bracket sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/office-brackets (read-only).
Nora: Watch party? 7pm @The Tap on Friday for the late games, or virtual stream in #random-watch for folks remote.
Dan: In-person for me. Count me in for pub 7pm.
Kelsey: I'll RSVP + order a few vegetarian pizzas. :thumbsup:
Sam L: :partyparrot: Great. Lock Friday noon unless majority votes for swap. Poll ends in 24h. GL everyone — may your brackets be cursed appropriately.
Mateo R: Good luck everyone :crossed_fingers:
Priya K: Also placing a small side bet on the 12-seed upsets. Who's with me? :eyes:
Jin W: Noted. Can't wait for the chaos.
Kelsey: Collection link posted in thread and pinned by @OpsBot. Venmo, cash, or Stripe accepted.
OpsBot: Poll closed in 24h — majority chose 'Allow 1 Swap'. Rules updated and pinned.
Sam L: Rules updated. One swap until Sunday midnight, $5 entry, tiebreaker = combined final score. Snacks = winner picks for a week, @Priya already volunteered pizza. Good luck! :trophy:
